body:
## Summary
One module, tools/evidence/scope.mjs, decides which paths an evidence kind can possibly read. run.mjs uses it in the three places that today treat every path alike: the dirty-tree gate, the import-churn check, and a new carry step that re-stamps an existing envelope onto HEAD when nothing in scope changed since it was built.

## Description
The pipeline keys freshness on HEAD and refuses or fails on any porcelain line. But 60.6% of commits touch only docs/evidence (lane JOURNAL/REPORT, logs, stills), and lanes write logs into evidence/ while a run is going. So an inert JOURNAL edit fails unit-tests evidence, an untracked PNG refuses the run, and a REPORT commit after a 13-minute green run stales all seven envelopes. Today the inert set is a belief kept in prose ("scratch output goes to build/ while it runs, and no tracked edits during it"). This card makes it a declared rule (docs/**, evidence/**, root JOURNAL.md and REPORT.md), plus a guard test that fails if any evidence kind's tool starts reading those roots. Carry only re-stamps `commit` to HEAD, whose in-scope tree is byte-identical, and appends a "carried from <sha>" summary suffix. builtAt, status, counts, metrics and artifacts are kept, so the pof.godot-evidence/1 shape and kind enum do not change. A failed envelope is carried as failed, so nothing is laundered. --fresh forces a full run.

## Flow
- run.mjs start: classify porcelain -> refuse only on code dirt; inert dirt is named in a summary suffix
- per kind: build/evidence/<kind>.json exists, its commit A is an ancestor of HEAD, godotVersion matches, git diff --name-only A HEAD is all inert -> carry (no Godot); otherwise run the kind
- unit churn: only code-path churn fails the kind
- the scope.test guard keeps the inert premise true as the tools evolve

## Expected impact
The end-of-session evidence re-run after a REPORT/JOURNAL commit drops from 7-13 min to seconds. The dirty-tree refusal over logs, PNGs and JOURNAL edits stops (4 lane reports cite it), and so does the false unit-tests FAIL on inert churn (13 committed logs). Lanes no longer need --allow-dirty (67 mentions in 18 lane docs), which today stamps a dirty note into every PoF summary.

## Evaluation
Claim: evidence freshness and dirt checks should follow what the kinds read, not raw HEAD/porcelain.
Before: 3343 of 5520 non-merge commits since 2026-11-02 (60.6%) touch only docs/, evidence/ or root JOURNAL/REPORT.md, and each one stales all 7 kinds. 13 committed evidence logs carry "tree changed during run", and every listed churn path is inert. --allow-dirty has 67 hits in 18 lane docs. A --no-bench run takes about 7-13 min.
After: 0 refusals or churn FAILs from inert paths. An evidence run whose diff from the last run is inert-only finishes in under 10 s with all kinds carried. Code dirt is still refused, as today.
Method: probe - classified git log --name-only over 5520 commits; ran git grep "tree changed during run" -- evidence; grepped every evidence tool for reads of docs/ or evidence/ and found none (tools/tests/save_crash.mjs only WRITES evidence/autosave and is not an evidence kind).
Result: better
Gate: contract
evidence: classification -> {commits:5520, inert:3343, pct:60.6}. git grep -l 'tree changed during run' -- evidence -> 13 files; churn tails: 'M JOURNAL.md' x3, 'M  JOURNAL.md' x2, 'M REPORT.md' x2, 'M REPORT.md, M docs/perf/LEDGER.md, ?? evidence/perf/l4b-bc7cv/bc7cv-import.patch.gz', 'M REPORT.md, M docs/ghosts/ghost-attacks.md', 'M JOURNAL.md, M REPORT.md, ?? evidence/n7-melee/scenarios-edb40f7c.log', '?? evidence/it11/padwalk/, ?? evidence/it12/padwalk2/'. grep -- --allow-dirty docs/*/*/*/{REPORT,JOURNAL}.md -> 18 files, 67 hits. Evidence tools that read docs/ or evidence/: none (tools/debt/metrics.mjs:52 reads justfile + AGENTS.md; tools/lint/lint.mjs:35-36 walks project/data and steam/).

## Summary
`node tools/evidence/cites.mjs <REPORT.md|decisions.md>...` pulls every backtick-cited path out of a lane report or a decision line. It expands braces and itN..itM ranges, checks file:line, and resolves declared root aliases (M/, masters/). Each miss prints with its line and a suggestion from the nearest tracked path. Lanes do this check by hand at the end of every session today.

## Description
PoF and the owner read the REPORT tables of `evidence/...` paths, which makes the cites as load-bearing as the gates. 20 of 50 lane reports spend a REPORT-phase step saying every path was re-checked by hand, and misses still ship: decisions.md:137 has cited a non-existent evidence/cop-gate.json since 2026-11-03. Someone found that by hand and it was never fixed. The tool gives each cite one status. OK. MISSING, with a basename-match suggestion over git ls-files. MISSING-LINE. UNTRACKED: on disk but not committed, so it dies with the worktree. PATTERN: a placeholder or glob. UNCHECKED: an undeclared root. It accepts one canonical header form `Paths: \`M/\` = \`<dir>\`` and also parses the prose variants already in the reports where it can.

## Flow
- extract `...` tokens starting with evidence/, project/, tools/, docs/, native/, frames/ or a declared alias
- expand {a,b} and itN..itM; split :L, :L,M and :L-M
- resolve; suggest by basename; print 'file:line path STATUS (hint)' + one summary line; exit 1 on MISSING/MISSING-LINE (+UNTRACKED with --tracked, +UNCHECKED with --strict)

## Expected impact
The REPORT-phase path re-check (20/50 reports) becomes one command that runs in under a second. Stale cites in decisions.md and the reports surface with the fix suggested, and untracked evidence is caught before its worktree is removed.

## Evaluation
Claim: lanes hand-verify cited evidence paths every session, and misses still ship.
Before: 20/50 REPORT.md describe a manual path re-check. A naive probe (backtick tokens under evidence|project|tools|docs|native, no expansion) over 51 docs (50 reports + decisions.md) finds 112 of 751 cites unresolved, worst n-d5 37 and n-noir 37 (mostly worktree-local untracked evidence, which the real tool separates out). Among them is the confirmed real miss at decisions.md:137.
After: one command per report, under 1 s. The cop-gate miss prints with 'did you mean evidence/d5-cast/cop-gate.json'. Range and brace false positives (held 'it1..it4', autosave 'patches/0001..0005') resolve.
Method: probe - a read-only node script over git ls-files docs/*REPORT.md + docs/decisions.md, existsSync per cite.
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: probe {files:51, tot:751, miss:112}; worst: n-d5 37, n-noir 37, human-reactions 12, visual-fixes 6, showcase 4, ranged 4. Samples: docs/decisions.md -> evidence/cop-gate.json (real miss; git ls-files | grep cop-gate -> evidence/d5-cast/cop-gate.json); docs/day/2026-11-05/held/REPORT.md -> evidence/held-it1..it4-reel-director.log (range); docs/day/2026-11-03/d5-cast/REPORT.md -> project/dev/showcase/d5_hero.gd:7,57 (multi-line cite). grep -liE 'every..path..checked|re-checked every path|path check' docs/*/*/*/REPORT.md -> 20 of 50. 10 reports declare a root alias (M/, masters/, <masters>) in free prose.

checked: Read .githooks/{pre-commit,post-checkout,post-merge,post-commit,pre-push}, justfile, AGENTS.md and .perfect/Perfect/directions/staged-lint-hook.md. Grepped lane REPORT/JOURNAL files under docs/{day,night,eve} for --no-verify (7 docs), --allow-dirty (18 docs, 67 hits), manual path re-checks (20/50 reports) and evidence-window misses (view70 JOURNAL:649, rivet JOURNAL:925). The staged-lint-hook premise still holds: .githooks/pre-commit:4 is the whole-tree `exec node tools/lint/lint.mjs`, and lint.mjs accepts only --json, with no path list. It is adoptable (.githooks/* is Class C; the coordinator applies it) and it is named as the slot-A runner-up. It was not chosen as primary because the evidence-scope card removes a larger cost: 7-13 min re-runs and refusals tied to 60.6% of commits. Card B targets lane-workflow directly by replacing the REPORT-phase manual path re-check.
